title: Empirically anchored synthetic electorate LLM voting experiment
scientific_question: Given only information available before an election, can aggregate ballot decisions generated by a frozen LLM over an empirically constrained synthetic electorate improve territorial vote-share forecasts beyond the frozen structural baseline, and does bounded peer interaction add incremental value beyond independent LLM voters?
core_principle: The synthetic society for election t is anchored to the exact observed turnout and party shares of election t-1, then asked to transition to t using only pre-election demographic, structural, candidate and event information. The target-election outcome is never used to calibrate the population, prompt, context or aggregation.

population_model.construction: maximum-entropy / iterative proportional fitting subject to authoritative demographic marginals; do not invent unsupported demographic correlations

political_anchor.mass_constraint: weighted archetype masses must reproduce the previous election turnout and party shares exactly within numerical tolerance
political_anchor.assignment_rule: minimize demographic-party dependence unless an explicit pre-target empirical source supports it
political_anchor.forbidden: invented ideology, invented partisan identification, or demographic stereotypes used as factual priors

data_power_gate.demographic_extended_required: education + activity/employment with explicit hierarchical fallback

information_packet.party_identity: opaque_id with mapping sealed from historical judges
information_packet.candidate_identity: opaque_id for historical benchmarks; no target-outcome identifying text

llm_contract.prompt: one frozen prompt for all territories and elections
llm_contract.sampling: deterministic primary pass; retries only for schema-invalid output with identical prompt and no semantic feedback
llm_contract.independence_rule: judge each archetype independently; no inference from other rows in the batch

output_per_archetype.conditional_party_probabilities: simplex across parties available in that territory
output_per_archetype.reason_codes: closed enum referencing only supplied evidence families

arms.description: Frozen structural baseline appropriate to the target election; F0 for 2026.
Synthetic electorate with no LLM transition: previous-election vote/abstention state carried forward. Control for the population construction itself.
Frozen LLM transition for each weighted voter archetype using the voter card and pre-election territory card, with no peer signal. Primary Agent Society treatment.
Negative control: candidate/event context is deterministically permuted across comparable territories/parties while preserving evidence density. Must not improve relative to true-context AS2.

Optional second-stage treatment. Same frozen AS2 cognition plus bounded numerical peer-intention summaries over a preregistered synthetic network. No free-form persuasion messages. Run only after AS2 passes historical sanity gates.

aggregation.expected_prediction: weight-sum of turnout_probability times conditional party probabilities
aggregation.uncertainty: simulate 20000 whole-election ballot realizations from frozen archetype probabilities with common random numbers across comparable arms
aggregation.legal_allocator: existing frozen 2026 allocator for seat conversion where applicable

metrics.primary: macro_party_share_RMSE over the frozen 92 x 9 panel

historical_sanity_gates.purpose: Engineering and plausibility filter only; not pristine proof because the protocol is designed after historical outcomes are known to the orchestrator.

execution_order: Freeze this protocol before ASV2 outcome-scored execution.
Build and certify constituency-to-census crosswalk and demographic marginals.
Build 2016, 2021 and 2026 synthetic populations from only prior-election political anchors and pre-target demographic data.
Run the data-power audit. Stop if it fails.
Build blinded pre-election information packets and seal identity mappings for historical benchmarks.
Contract-test the frozen LLM prompt on synthetic dummy packets only; do not repair it after real benchmark outputs are inspected.
Run AS1, AS2 and AS2_SHUFFLED_CONTEXT on 2016 and 2021; score as retrospective diagnostics.
If historical sanity passes, freeze the 2026 AS2 forecast before election day. F0 remains official and unchanged.
Run AS3 only if its separate gate passes; freeze separately.
After the 2026 election, score F0 vs AS2 and, if executed, AS3 under the frozen contract and issue one terminal certificate.
anti_drift: No target outcome may influence population construction, prompt wording, evidence selection, aggregation, thresholds or model choice.
Do not call 2016 or 2021 a pristine holdout in V2.
No synthetic demographic correlation is treated as real without a source.
No historical model memory is allowed to identify parties or territories in blinded benchmarks.
No LLM narrative receives scientific credit; only aggregate predictive metrics count.
No political persuasion, voter targeting, party strategy or real personal voter data.
